headline: [Massive Attack!] Ukraine Fires Nearly [1,200 Drones] at Russia Overnight
sub: Russia says it shot down 1,198 drones
caption:
⚠️ Ukraine Fires Nearly 1,200 Drones at Russia Overnight

Ukraine launched almost 1,200 drones at Russia overnight from Thursday to Friday, one of its biggest air attacks since the full-scale war began nearly five years ago. Russia's Defence Ministry said its air defences shot down 1,198 drones over more than 15 regions.

🔹 Russian officials reported deaths. At least four workers were killed in an industrial area in the Volgograd region, the regional governor said.
🔹 Moscow's mayor said 467 drones were heading for the capital. Russia also attacked Ukraine overnight; Ukrainian officials said at least two people were killed in Odesa.
🔹 The attack came after two days of US-led talks in Abu Dhabi. US envoys say Europe will join the next round of peace talks.

💬 Do you think the peace talks can stop the war? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, AFP
